# PE VMS — PE Venue Management System

Booking app for PE venues at Rosyth School (GitHub Pages version).

* `index.html` — the app (built from the Apps Script `Index.html`; do not edit by hand)
* `config.js` — the link to the Apps Script back office (`/exec` URL)
* `manifest.webmanifest`, `sw.js`, `icons/` — home-screen app set-up

Data lives in the PE VMS Google Sheet. Every change is checked by the Apps Script server and needs the teacher's PIN.

Developed by Mr Salihin · Rosyth PE
